title: Friday on my Mind | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Friday on my Mind is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Nestled in the serene landscape of WaterColor, 'Friday on my Mind' is a remarkable 2-story home that invites you to indulge in coastal luxury. Boasting 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, including a bunk area with 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunk beds, this haven comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests.As you step onto the front porch adorned with a classic swing, a sense of tranquility surrounds you. The first floor welcomes you with a spacious, open-floor plan seamlessly connecting the well-equipped kitchen, an expansive dining table for 8, and a living area adorned with ample seating. An additional 5 seats at the kitchen island ensure everyone can gather comfortably.The master bedroom beckons with a king bed and a private bathroom featuring an oversized walk-in shower and a tub for ultimate relaxation. Step out onto the balcony from the master bedroom, a perfect spot for sipping morning coffee and embracing the day. A charming sleeping nook offers 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunk beds. Each of the three additional bedrooms comes complete with its own private bathroom, providing convenience and privacy for every guest.Beyond the tranquility of your retreat, the emerald waters of the Gulf are just a short drive away. Delight in exploring WaterColor's abundant amenities, from community pools to winding biking paths and expansive greenways. You're only a 2-minute walk to the WaterColor Dragonfly pool!A stay at Friday on my Mind gets you access to The Beach Club and Camp WaterColor, reserved solely for WaterColor guests. The Beach Club offers three pools, abundant seating on multiple decks, and inviting lounge areas right on the Gulf of Mexico. Delight in a diverse range of resort dining experiences, from savoring coastal poolside grill favorites to crafting your own burgers and indulging in made-to-order shakes. The fun doesn't stop there! Camp WaterColor, offers two pools, slides, a lazy river, a basketball court and playground. There's also plenty of dining options and sweet treats here!WaterColor:The moment you turn into the WaterColor community, you are sure to feel a great sense of comfort as the quaint, beachy community welcomes you. With all of the wonderful amenities provided by this home and the beautiful WaterColor community, you and your guests are sure to have an amazing and memorable trip! With less than a 1.7 mile distance to both the Seaside and Watercolor town centers, you are only a short walk, bike, or drive from fun family activities, delicious restaurants, and desirable boutiques in the nearby surrounding communities.Your stay at Friday on my Mind comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!***Please note that there will be ongoing roadwork in the area beginning January 12. Guests are welcome to contact us with any questions regarding parking during this project.***Additional Information:* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 3 cars.* Wristbands are required for all guests over the age of five by the Community AssociationA Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
